basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old hobbyist game designer from Toronto, Canada, with a passion for historical reenactments and miniatures gaming. My journey into the world of Reddit began about a year and a half ago, mainly to connect with other wargaming enthusiasts and to share ideas. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies. I'm single, enjoy hiking, and often spend my evenings online, particularly between 7 PM and 11 PM EST, discussing game mechanics or exploring new game concepts. I dislike overly commercialized games and prefer community-driven projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design with a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree from OCAD University. My interest in wargaming and miniatures developed through my involvement in local historical reenactment groups and self-study. Over the years, I've attended numerous conventions and workshops, enhancing my understanding of game mechanics and design principles.
